layman_headline: Market fear is elevated and no swing candidate offers a clean enough setup to justify risking capital right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 28 out of 100, and that mood has been worsening all week. Bitcoin is roughly flat while most altcoins are drifting lower. The candidates on the watchlist either have conflicting signals (like TRUMP being oversold but in a clear downtrend), are too illiquid or obscure to trust (BEAT, UB, 币安人生), or have already made their move (ADA up 21.8% this week). None of them offer the combination of a clean technical setup, a strong catalyst, and manageable risk that a good swing trade requires.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is fearful and trending down — trying to catch a falling knife here has poor odds. Watch for Fear & Greed to stabilize or for a clear oversold bounce on a quality asset before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Fear & Greed at 28 is close to the 25 threshold where Rule 3 says outlook is genuinely ambiguous. Weekly trend is worsening (27→28 today but avg 27.6). BTC dominance at 56.4% signals capital rotation into BTC and away from alts, which is bearish for every swing candidate on the list. TRUMP has the strongest single signal (RSI 26, which has a 71% win rate historically per signal credibility data), but the chart bias is -0.70 with price below all MAs in a confirmed downtrend — the RSI oversold signal alone cannot overcome bearish structure in a fearful market. BEAT shows a -39.7% weekly drop but RSI at 58 (not oversold), which is contradictory and suggests unreliable data. WLD has decent risk/reward (2.41x) but bearish chart structure and no catalyst. AAVE is the most legitimate DeFi project but is neutral on all indicators with no edge. The responsible decision is to preserve capital and wait for a higher-probability setup.

Macro headwinds from yen intervention fears and regulatory uncertainty (Clarity Act) are suppressing sentiment, while institutional activity (BlackRock tokenization, Bitmine ETH buys) provides a longer-term floor.
context_banner: Fear is elevated and worsening — capital preservation takes priority over chasing setups in a deteriorating market.
